pairs: If it is necessary (though certainly not expedient) to glory,
veniam autem ad visiones et revelationes Domini.
then I will next tell of visions and revelations from the Lord.
Scio hominem in Christo ante annos quatuordecim,
I know a man in Christ, who, more than fourteen years ago (whether in the body,
sive in corpore nescio, sive extra corpus nescio,
I do not know, or out of the body,
raptum hujusmodi usque ad tertium cælum.
God knows), was enraptured to the third heaven.
Et scio hujusmodi hominem sive in corpore,
And I know a certain man (whether in the body,
or out of the body, I do not know:
And he heard words of mystery,
which it is not permitted for man to speak.
On behalf of someone like this, I will glory.
pro me autem nihil gloriabor nisi in infirmitatibus meis.
But on behalf of myself, I will not glory about anything, except my infirmities.
For even though I am willing to glory,
But I will speak the truth.
Yet I will do so sparingly,
ne quis me existimet supra id quod videt in me,
lest anyone may consider me to be anything more than what he sees in me,
or anything more than what he hears from me.
Et ne magnitudo revelationum extollat me,
And lest the greatness of the revelations should extol me,
datus est mihi stimulus carnis meæ angelus Satanæ,
there was given to me a prodding in my flesh: an angel of Satan,
Propter quod ter Dominum rogavi ut discederet a me:
Because of this, three times I petitioned the Lord that it might be taken away from me.
For virtue is perfected in weakness.” And so,
Libenter igitur gloriabor in infirmitatibus meis, ut inhabitet in me virtus Christi.
willingly shall I glory in my weaknesses, so that the virtue of Christ may live within me.
Propter quod placeo mihi in infirmitatibus meis,
Because of this, I am pleased in my infirmity: in reproaches,
Ego enim a vobis debui commendari:
For I ought to have been commended by you.
nihil enim minus fui ab iis, qui sunt supra modum Apostoli:
For I have been nothing less than those who claim to be above the measure of Apostles,
signa tamen apostolatus mei facta sunt super vos in omni patientia,
And the seal of my Apostleship has been set over you, with all patience,
in signis, et prodigiis, et virtutibus.
with signs and wonders and miracles.
Quid est enim, quod minus habuistis præ ceteris ecclesiis,
For what is there that you have had which is less than the other churches,
nisi quod ego ipse non gravavi vos?
except that I myself did not burden you?
Ecce tertio hoc paratus sum venire ad vos:
Behold, this is the third time I have prepared to come to you,
and yet I will not be a burden to you.
Non enim quæro quæ vestra sunt,
For I am seeking not the things that are yours,
sed vos. Nec enim debent filii parentibus thesaurizare,
but you yourselves. And neither should the children store up for the parents,
but the parents for the children.
et super impendar ipse pro animabus vestris:
I will spend and exhaust myself for the sake of your souls,
licet plus vos diligens, minus diligar.
loving you more, while being loved less.
Numquid per aliquem eorum, quod misi ad vos, circumveni vos?
And yet, did I defraud you by means of any of those whom I sent to you?
and I sent a brother with him.
Did we not walk with the same spirit?
Did we not walk in the same steps?
Olim putatis quod excusemus nos apud vos?
Have you ever thought that we should explain ourselves to you?
We speak in the sight of God, in Christ.
Timeo enim ne forte cum venero,
inveniam vos: et ego inveniar a vobis,
I might not find you such as I would want,
and I might be found by you,
such as you would not want.
For perhaps there may be among you:
If so, then, when I have arrived,
God may again humble me among you.
et lugeam multos ex iis qui ante peccaverunt,
And so, I mourn for the many who sinned beforehand,
et non egerunt pœnitentiam super immunditia, et fornicatione,
